divergesFromReason: Angular delegates Toast to Angular Material's MatSnackBar (frameworks/angular/behaviour-delegated.json), which owns one surface with one role and does not vary by tone -- its binding stays the flat pattern "alert" it always was. React's Toast varies role and aria-live by tone, so it is cased and the more precise of the two. This is a real cross-layer divergence, not a defect in either side: nothing asserts MatSnackBar should switch role by tone, and behaviour-delegated.json's Toast entry is accurate about what Material does and is left untouched.

exceptions.reason: Toast.jsx has no timer of its own, but its doc comment describes toasts as auto-dismissed by the host by default and `persist` as the opt-out. Nothing in this file enforces persist for a critical state, so the claim rests on the host.

cases.name: advisory
cases.when: any other tone -- role="status" with aria-live="polite"
